settings.label: Local library index
settings.help: Path to MyGo Music's local/index.json. The default is the one beside this plugin's data folder.

settings.label: LRCLib endpoint
settings.help: A LRCLib-compatible server. Default: https://lrclib.net. Its host must be in the plugin's network permission.

settings.label: Cache lifetime (hours)
settings.help: How long a found lyric is kept before LRCLib is asked again. Default: 168 (one week). Set 0 to turn caching off.

settings.label: Request timeout (ms)
settings.help: How long to wait for LRCLib per request. Default: 8000.

settings.label: Write .lrc beside local songs
settings.help: Default: true. Writes found lyrics beside your audio files, so they show while playing from Local Files too. Existing .lrc files are never overwritten. Set false to stop.

settings.label: Songs per background sync
settings.help: Default: 25. How many songs may be looked up each time the app starts or plays a song; keeps the load on the public LRCLib service small.

settings.label: Background sync interval (minutes)
settings.help: Default: 15. Minimum minutes between two background lookups.
